entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Petitioner has filed this writ application with a prayer to direct the Respondent No.
3-District Land Acquisition Officer, Bokaro to consider his objection under section 3C and 3G of National Highways Act, 1956 in lieu of acquisition of land and to pay and release the compensation within the specified period.
2. Petitioner is claiming ownership of the land appertaining to Plot No. 2951 under Khata No. 634 in Mouza Chas which was acquired by the Respondent No. 2 for the purposes of widening of NH-32.

Notices were published in the Gazette under section 3A and 3D of the National Highways Act, 1956,
informing that the aforesaid land was acquired for widening of NH- 32.
The name of the vendors of the petitioner have been shown as interested persons in the Notification dated 22.05.2014.
Petitioner is said to have purchased the aforesaid land through various registered sale deeds executed on several dates which are Annexure-1 series 3.
It is case of the petitioner that his name was entered into the Revenue Records and he was paying rent to the State Government and the State Government was issuing rent receipts to him.

Petitioner filed several objections section 3C of the National Highways Act, 1956 before the Respondent No. 3- Banwari Lal Agrawal vs The State Of Jharkhand on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/101095093/
1

entities.text: Banwari Lal Agrawal vs The State Of Jharkhand on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: District Land Acquisition Officer, Bokaro and the last objection was filed on 15.06.2015 (Annexure-7),
which has not been disposed of as yet.

4. Grievance of the petitioner is that the Respondent No. 3-District Land Acquisition Officer, Bokaro is sitting over the matter and has not passed any order despite the fact that the matter is being continuously agitated before him for the last eight years.

5. As per section 3H(4) of National Highways Act, 1956, competent authority has to refer the objection to the Principal Civil Court of original jurisdiction within the limits of whose jurisdiction the land is situated.

It was submitted that the land in question lies within the territorial jurisdiction of the Civil Court, Bokaro and the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Bokaro has been notified as competent authority to adjudicate upon the dispute arising out of the National Highways Act, 1956.
6.

entities.text: Principal District and Sessions Judge, Bokaro
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Accordingly, Respondent No. 3 - District Land Acquisition Officer, Bokaro is directed to refer the objection to the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Bokaro for adjudicating the dispute which is being agitated by the petitioner.

entities.text: Principal District and Sessions Judge, Bokaro
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The Respondent No. 3 shall forward the objection of the petitioner to the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Bokaro within four weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order.

entities.text: Principal District and Sessions Judge, Bokaro
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 7. With this direction, this writ application is disposed of.
